item.description: California Forward describes itself as a multi-partisan, nonprofit organization building a New California Economy that is sustainable, resilient and inclusive.

item.title: Federal cuts could shutter farm to food bank program
item.description: The Local Food Purchase Assistance Program, known in California as Farms Together, pays farmers fair market prices to supply fresh foods directly to local food banks. Since the program launched in January 2024, it has supported 800 farms statewide and fed more than 2 million Californians.

item.title: Photo | Flower bloom along Santa Cruz Bikeway
item.description: Birds of paradise and a calla lily bloom along Bay Street in Santa Cruz as a cyclist pedals by near Redwood Street. The bike path accessed by the cyclist is part of the Santa Cruz Bikeway, an 11-mile, segmented bike route designed to minimize exposure to car traffic. (Shmuel Thaler – Santa Cruz Sentinel)

item.description: A group of surfers is working to create a female surfer statue on East Cliff Drive.
